wolfram.note: D(Sign(x),x) reduces to a blanket 0, but Sign has a delta-function derivative at 0 so this only holds a.e.; Wolfram deliberately leaves it symbolic (Derivative(1)(Sign)(x)). The rule lives in compute-engine's own native derivative table (nothing in our analytic/arithmetic packages declares it), so fixing it means a new ce-patches derivative override, not a change in this lane's files.
Compute-engine reads Infinity*i as the undirected ComplexInfinity, so Sign is Indeterminate. Wolfram keeps the direction (DirectedInfinity[I]) and Sign is I. Directed infinities are not represented.
